name: turbopuffer
description: Work with turbopuffer, a serverless vector and full-text search database. Provides the `/tpuf` skill with on-demand references for querying (vector ANN, BM25, hybrid), writing, schema management, and troubleshooting. Registers a turbopuffer MCP server with `execute` (run TypeScript SDK code against your namespaces) and `search_docs` (search turbopuffer documentation).
